instruction:
Implement WP-SCP-022 Track 1 slice 020B.2 per WP-SCP-020 §4 row 020B.2.

Ships the local-reproduction CLI for the policy-check workflow. Same Rego bundle / inputs / invocation as CI; single source of truth in lib/policy_check_invocation.sh sourced by both.

## Acceptance criteria (WP-SCP-020 §4 020B.2 sub-i..vi)

1. (i) `scripts/.tool-versions` committed with OPA + Conftest versions (current pinned versions per .github/workflows/policy-check.yml).
2. (ii) `scripts/scp-policy-check.lock` JSON with SHA256 of both binaries for the four platforms: linux-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-arm64, darwin-x64. Script prints clear error + exits non-zero on unlisted platform.
3. (iii) `scripts/scp-policy-check` shell script downloads OPA + Conftest at first run, verifies SHA256 against lockfile, refuses on mismatch (security-critical).
4. (iv) Offline support: if binaries already present at expected paths (e.g. `~/.cache/scp/<version>/opa`), skip download.
5. (v) Identical Rego bundle / inputs / invocation as CI. Single source of truth: `lib/policy_check_invocation.sh` sourced by both `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml` and `scripts/scp-policy-check`. The CI workflow needs editing to source this lib (cross-slice fix, authorised — same rationale as 020B.1 fix-round-1 for fixture-path).
6. (vi) `.github/dependabot.yml` watches `scripts/.tool-versions` so OPA/Conftest upstream releases auto-PR against SCP with lockfile bumps. (Use Dependabot's `package-ecosystem: github-actions` or a custom watcher; if Dependabot doesn't natively support .tool-versions, implement via Renovate rule in `renovate/default.json` — that file lands in slice 020F, so for 020B.2 just write the dependabot.yml stub even if Dependabot doesn't fire.)
7. Also: `python -m standards_control_plane.policy_check` Python entrypoint that delegates to the same shell script (or duplicates the invocation contract).

## Tests

`tests/scripts/test_scp_policy_check.py`:
- platform-detection negative case (mock platform.machine)
- SHA256 mismatch refusal
- offline-mode happy path (mock binary already present)

## Constraints

- DO NOT add Rego rules (020C scope).
- DO NOT modify policies/ contents.
- DO NOT touch DECISIONS.md / BACKLOG.md / STATUS.md.
- D-021 reservation respected.
verify_commands: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('scripts/scp-policy-check.lock')); assert all(k in d for k in ('opa','conftest')); assert all(p in d['opa'] for p in ('linux-x64','linux-arm64','darwin-arm64','darwin-x64'))"
